Tuesday, August 2

Today we went to a culture center. We learned about traditional Hawaiian culture there. First, we learned what some Hawaiian words mean. ⓐ"알로하는 '안녕하세요' 또는 '안녕히 가세요'라고 말하는 데 사용된다, and "mahalo" means "thank you." Then it was hula dance time! Surprisingly, many of the movements ⓑrepresented things in nature. (A)______, if you raise your arms above your head ⓒ______, it stands for the moon. When I danced hula, I could feel the Hawaiian people's love for nature.
ⓓ수빈이네 집으로 돌아가는 길에, we saw a big, beautiful rainbow. Soobin explained, "You can often see rainbows in Hawaii. (B)______, Hawaii is called the Rainbow State."
